scope: Read-only LIVE aggregates for the previously approved Drummonds public-channel fixed-window campaign; no provider request, message body, DM read, campaign mutation or manual worker invocation.
outcome: The approved fixed-window public-channel campaign reached its ordinary terminal state with all observed reply threads imported and no campaign channel awaiting review.
limits: This proves the configured fixed window and observed roots, not messages deleted, inaccessible or absent from Slack retention.
